description: Wing FTP Server <= 7.4.3 unauthenticated RCE via NULL byte injection in the username parameter during login. Improper NULL byte handling allows Lua code injection into session files, which are executed on authenticated endpoint access (/dir.html). Anonymous login must be enabled.
impact: Unauthenticated remote code execution with elevated privileges when anonymous login is enabled on Wing FTP Server.
preconditions: Anonymous login enabled on the server
